newsitem.title: CANADA: Northrock hits high after asset sale news.
newsitem.headline: Northrock hits high after asset sale news.

text.p: Northrock Resources Ltd stock climbed to a 52-week high in busy volume on Tuesday after the company said it would soon be flush with cash following a sale of non-strategic oil and gas properties.

Northrock jumped 0.15 to 15.15 in early trade on volume of 1.4 million shares, making it the Toronto Stock Exchange's most-active issue on Tuesday. Northrock shares have climbed from 12.15 on January 9.
The company said on Monday it agreed to a conditional sale of assets expected to garner proceeds of C$45 million.
The deal was contingent on the purchaser, a royalty trust, closing an initial public offering of units, expected on March 1.
Northrock said it would use the cash to reduce its bank debt, allowing it more flexibility to pursue exploration, development and acquisition opportunities.
It also said the production lost from the sale was expected to be replaced from first-quarter exploration and development.
